manualReason: ImageJ 1.x releases use letter suffixes (for example 1.54t) that the shared numeric release parser does not accept. Check the first entry of https://wsr.imagej.net/jars/list.txt (the release list read by Help > Update ImageJ) and the release notes; ignore daily builds such as 1.54u8.
scope: Fresh integrated source-bound native qualification: ImageJ1.54t bounded threshold-particle and repeated named rectangular grayscale-region measurements, declared common calibration/frame time, independent every-pixel count/min/max/mean and calibrated area, fractional8/16bit cases, operation-specific live Java timeout/cancel and fully refreshed semantic mutants. Typed CSV to Calc26.8.1.1 verified all128Data/Summary cells perODS/XLSX for the fractional/nonunit fixture. No tracking/registration/general segmentation/biological or acquisition-quality claim; jar hashes establish retained consistency rather than publisher authenticity.
acceptance: Run tools/qualify_imagej_fixtures.py --check and tools/qualify_imagej.py with the target ij.jar and a Java 11+ runtime (plus Calc for the handoff); require all analytic synthetic-target cases, native kit tamper/timeout/cancellation probes and the Calc table readback.

Run tools/qualify_imagej_series_fixtures.py --check and tools/qualify_imagej_regions.py with the target ij.jar and a Java 11+ runtime (plus Calc for the typed handoff); require the analytic baseline and variant, refusals before native launch, tamper with refreshed digests, operation-specific timeout and cancellation lifecycle, changed-input invalidation, fractional-mean and non-unit-area handoff and the independent ODF/OOXML cell readback. Re-read ImageStack, ImagePlus, Roi and ImageStatistics API pages and the ImageJ release list before absorbing a release; keep absorbedVersion unchanged until this passes.
